_readme: RFC 9180 Appendix A.1.1 — DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, AES-128-GCM, base mode. Extracted verbatim from https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9180.txt (FETCHED 2026-09-08) by a script, not transcribed. This is the court for every part of the composition that WISHMail shares with a published suite. Specification §7.3 differs from it in exactly two places: aead_id 0x0002 rather than 0x0001 in the key schedule suite_id, and a 32-byte AES key rather than 16. Everything else is identical, and app/src/core/seal.check.ts runs the same code at these parameters and asserts every value below. The private keys here are the RFC’s own published test material and are no agent’s key (D-151).
